The aim is to provide a snapshot of some of the most exciting work published in the various research areas of the journal. It covers a wide range of topics on the subject and provides comprehensive guidance for privacy auditing schemes based on privacy attacks to protect machine-learning models from privacy leakage. Our results contribute to the growing literature on differential privacy in the realm of privacy auditing and beyond and pave the way for future research in the field of privacy-preserving models. differential privacy; differential private machine learning; differential privacy auditing; privacy attacks. In this context, DP is a powerful privacy-preserving tool to prevent sensitive information about an individual from being revealed in a variety of ML models and to analyze the privacy of/from the training data.
